coaching.headline: We lost two fights we opened with a man advantage — 0-2 at their Fangtooth 5v4, then 0-4 at our own Primal 5v3 — and the second one ended the game at their hands on our core.
coaching.team: Carry, mid and jungle all read favored and the mid and carry lanes were won on the film — this was a fight-execution loss, majors 13-27. The pattern was taking fights while our winning lanes stayed home: the macro flags fight after fight (2.5, 7.3, 14, 15.6, 16.3, 26.3) where a lane that was ahead never rotated. Then the two man-up disasters: 20.9 (5v4, lost 0-2) and 33.2 (5v3 at our Primal, lost 0-4, our core fell at 33.8). Numbers advantages have to be spent as a group — five bodies at one fight, not two here and two there.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 14-minute 0-4 at their outer tower cost Fangtooth at 15.1 plus three towers in one window, and the 33.2 five-versus-three loss at our Primal Fangtooth handed them the core 36 seconds later.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock won the carry lane on the film (ours all game against Skylar) yet finished 5/9 — the deaths came from repeated two-man fights with no objective up (12.7 in our half and 17.9 deep in our jungle, both tagged bad trades). The 14.1 death sat inside the window that cost Fangtooth and three towers. A won lane's job in this game was to shove and arrive at fights five-strong.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Riktor's 28 wards were the team's eyes, and the lane flipped late against Argus. The bigger point is the kit: Riplash, the silence and Skewer were our only pick tools, so fights needed to start from Riktor landing a hook — instead the team kept flipping fights while the macro shows Riktor pinned across the map (12.7, 17.9). Deaths at 14 and 26.3 fed the Fangtooth and Primal losses.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari went 10/6 with 15.3k objective damage and won the jungle read — the win condition was working. Two fixes: 1 ward all game, and the 20.9 Fangtooth fight went 0-2 while the macro shows the jungle alive and ahead — that was the fight where the fifth body flips it.

threats: Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

ourKits.combo: Web Lash root → Crushing Maw armor shred → Hellfire eye → Consume pull-channel
ourKits.winCondition: root with Web Lash and grind with Hunger-stacked haste
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst on his rooted target
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash — without the root he has no lock-down; interrupt Consume

enemyKits.combo: Pounce → Rumble slow → Boulder Throw → Behemoth ult to brawl
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Pounce, grow with Behemoth and out-sustain the fight
enemyKits.passive: ramping health regen for jungle sustain
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he front-lines and CCs
enemyKits.playAgainst: anti-heal and kiting beat his sustain brawl; burst him before Behemoth

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing

enemyKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
enemyKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
enemyKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel
